description: INE, the national statistics institute of Mozambique, publishes the final results of the 2017 General Population and Housing Census as Excel workbooks in its document library, one national and one for each of the 11 provinces. The national workbook has 76 sheets. Its housing tables count private dwellings, households and members by wall, roof and floor material, and by dwelling type against basic conditions. Energy rows separate grid electricity, generators or solar panels, gas, kerosene, candles, batteries and firewood. Water rows run from piped water in the house to standpipes, boreholes with hand pumps, wells, springs, rivers, rain and tankers, followed by waste collection and sanitation. Further sheets cover rooms, tenure, durable goods and use of computers, the internet and mobile phones by province. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX, no registration, under an INE open data licence that allows commercial use with acknowledgement. Caveats: labels are in Portuguese; the TLS chain served by ine.gov.mz is incomplete, so some clients need the DigiCert intermediate; the next census is planned for August 2027. Simulation uses: household energy source and water source by urban or rural area and province for electrification and water supply planning. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.

name: INE Mozambique IV General Population and Housing Census 2017 final results workbooks in Excel, national and one per province, with private dwellings by wall, roof and floor material and type, and by basic conditions including energy (grid electricity, generator or solar panel), water source, waste collection and sanitation, by urban or rural area
schema_summary: National workbook sheets Q1 to Q68: population, households, education, disability, orphanhood, mortality, fertility, then housing: Q49 dwellings, households and members by wall, roof and floor material; Q51 dwellings by type (conventional house, flat, palhota hut, improvised, mixed, basic) and basic conditions: energy (electricity, generator or solar panel, gas, kerosene, candles, batteries, firewood), water (piped inside or outside, neighbour, standpipe, borehole with hand pump, wells, spring, river, rain, tanker), waste collection (municipal, private, buried, burned, dumped) and sanitation; Q54 to Q59 rooms, tenure, occupancy; Q60 durable goods; Q61 to Q63 computer, internet and mobile phone use by province.
spatial_resolution: national by urban or rural area and province; separate workbooks for each of the 11 provinces
temporal_resolution: census every ten years (next census August 2027)
